capabilities: manage tasks in Inbox, Today, Upcoming and project lists from the sidebar
turn ordinary notes into projects whose checkboxes become to-dos
display projects as Kanban boards with draggable columns
capture to-dos quickly with natural-language dates, repeat rules and @project
add tasks from other apps via x-callback-url links
extras: Privacy note: fetching a page title for URL-only to-dos is the only network use, and it can be turned off in settings. Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later.
problem: Obsidian has task checkboxes but no built-in task-manager view with Inbox, Today and Upcoming lists or project boards built from regular notes.
summary: Task manager view that turns ordinary notes into an Inbox, Today and Upcoming lists, and projects, syncing everything back to plain Markdown checkboxes.
